WITH rating_daily_rates AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS daily_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(daily_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_daily_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(rdr.daily_rate) AS avg_daily_price,
  AVG(rdr.daily_rate) - oa.overall_avg AS avg_above_overall
FROM rating_daily_rates rdr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE rdr.daily_rate > oa.overall_avg
